text:
Lina: Side door saga — left unlocked again. It turned into an impromptu philosophy hour. Who claims responsibility for the key? :thinking_face:
Marco: not me. Also @Doorman Dan, your legend grows. Is there an ancient oath? :laughing:
Doorman Dan: I hereby accept the title. I eat granola bars in exchange for door wisdom. Rule 0: The Door Chooses. Rule 1: If you prop it, you tend it. Simple. :shield:
Sia: can we get a sticker? 'I tended the door and all I got was enlightenment' sticker. Vote? :raised_hands:
Priya: yes to sticker. also rename the side door to "The Vestibule of Intentions" — sounds like a startup podcast episode.
Lina: let's put the rules somewhere official. Drafting quick rules now:
```
Side Door Philosophy v0.1
- If you prop the door, you are temporarily Doorkeeper (max 30 minutes).
- Doorkeeper responsibilities: sweep crumbs, rescue lost umbrellas, offer tea.
- Doorkeeper earns one granola bar coupon from Doorman Dan.
- If door becomes a congregation site, offer a chair and a question.
```
Marco: love the granola bar coupon clause. petitioning for espresso vouchers too.
Doorman Dan: adding clause: anyone who initiates a midnight aphorism session owes donuts.
Sia: ops-bot can we make a low-effort poll? :robot_face:
ops-bot: Poll created: "Sticker for Side Door Philosophy?" Options: Yes / No / Make it a mural. (react to vote)
Priya: voted (Yes). :white_check_mark:
Marco: voted (Make it a mural). :artist_palette:
Lina: voted (Yes). :thumbsup:
Doorman Dan: voted (Yes) — sealing this with a solemn nod.
Sia: also side note: does anyone have a spare small folding chair? The Vestibule needs seating for deep questions.
Priya: I have one in my locker, bringing it tomorrow.
Lina: Okay we're officially a lore thread now. Tagging this for future onboarding as 'How to become a Doorkeeper.' :sparkles:
Marco: next step: ceremonial bell. I nominate @ops-bot to ding whenever a new Doorkeeper is installed.
ops-bot: noted. Will remind on schedule. :bell:
